reason: I'd ask for the free 12.5 cl sample because a fermented péi syrup is exactly my kind of thing, but we already make our own syrups and rhums arrangés in-house for a fraction of 23 euros a litre, so I'm not placing an order this month just on a description.
objection: At 23 euros HT a litre it costs about double a Monin and much more than what I make myself, and on top of that I have to store, track and send back deposit bottles, which is one more thing for my team to manage.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting the sample and finding a flavour I genuinely can't make in-house, plus them picking up the empties at the same time as delivery so the deposit costs me no effort.
